title: MyWork
summary: A personal Python project implementing a CTGAN-based data augmentation and evaluation pipeline for the WSN-DS wireless sensor network intrusion-detection dataset, with a vendored ctgan module and code that imports CTGAN through both the standalone ctgan package and SDV's compatibility layer. SDV's sdv.single_table/sdv.tabular CTGAN interfaces (plus SingleTableMetadata) and the standalone ctgan package are both directly instantiated to synthesize augmented training data.
evidence: wsn_ds_ctgan_aug.py:51-86 defines load_ctgan_class() trying sdv.single_table.CTGANSynthesizer/sdv.tabular.CTGAN and instantiates it; generate_evaluate.py:35 'from ctgan import CTGAN'
needs: Repo also contains an in-tree models/ctgan directory (vendored SDV-family copy); unclear whether that vendored copy or the pip-installed packages are what's actually executed at runtime.
